WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date='2026-03-01'),
b AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date='2026-03-08')
SELECT s.store_id, p.sku, p.category, p.delisted_on, p.is_current, p.valid_to, a.closing_units, a.closing_value FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING(store_key,product_key) JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE b.store_key IS NULL AND s.region='West' ORDER BY 1,2

WITH st AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-22')
SELECT st.week_ending_date, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(st.closing_value - st.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN st.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negunits, max(st.closing_value) mx, sum(CASE WHEN p.valid_from>st.week_ending_date OR p.valid_to<st.week_ending_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badver
FROM st JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=st.product_key WHERE s.region='West' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week
  WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=11)
                             AND (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=11)
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT p.category, k.week_ending_date, sum(k.closing_value) AS week_value
  FROM stock k
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = k.store_key AND s.region = 'West'
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = k.product_key
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category, round(avg(week_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_eur, count(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
